requirements.text: Account balance retrieval The system must retrieve the current balance of a specified account.
Account balance retrieval for default account The system must retrieve the current balance using a default account when no account name is specified.
Account not found error The system must raise a ValueError when the specified account does not exist in the data source.
Withholdings retrieval per account The system must return a formatted breakdown of withholdings (federal, state, local, Social Security, Medicare, 401k) for a given account.
Withholdings retrieval for default account The system must retrieve withholdings using a default account when no account name is specified.
Withholdings not found error The system must raise a ValueError when the specified account has no withholdings records.
Stock price retrieval The system must return the current price of a named stock ticker.
Stock price ticker not found error The system must raise a ValueError when the specified ticker symbol does not exist.
Investment portfolio retrieval The system must return the complete investment portfolio for a given account, listing each holding with ticker, shares, and current price.
Investment portfolio for default account The system must retrieve the investment portfolio using a default account when no account name is specified.
Investment portfolio not found error The system must raise a ValueError when the specified account has no investment portfolio.
Income records retrieval The system must return all income records (type, amount, frequency) for a given account.
Income records for default account The system must retrieve income records using a default account when no account name is specified.
Income records not found error The system must raise a ValueError when the specified account has no income records.
Expense records retrieval The system must return all expense records (type, amount, frequency) for a given account.
Expense records for default account The system must retrieve expense records using a default account when no account name is specified.
Expense records not found error The system must raise a ValueError when the specified account has no expense records.
Deductions retrieval The system must return a formatted list of deductions (type, amount, frequency) for a given account.
Deductions for default account The system must retrieve deductions using a default account when no account name is specified.
Deductions not found error The system must raise a ValueError when the specified account has no deductions records.
Data seeding on first access The system must seed initial financial data files for an account on first access if they do not already exist.

Configuration via CLI arguments and environment variables The system must accept configuration for data directory, port, transport type, and allowed users via CLI arguments with fallback to environment variables.
MCP SSE transport mode The system must support SSE (Server-Sent Events) transport mode for HTTP-based MCP communication.
MCP stdio transport mode The system must support stdio transport mode for CLI-based MCP communication.
Tool registration in MCP server The system must register all six finance tools (balance, withholdings, stock_price, investment_portfolio, income, expenses, deductions) as MCP tools.
Negative balances accepted The system must accept and return negative balance values.
README promises: CLI personal finance assistant via MCP The system must act as a personal finance CLI assistant exposing account data through the Model Context Protocol.
Configuration port range validation The system should validate that the port argument falls within the valid range of 1024-65535.
Fitness score computation The system must compute and return a fitness score based on financial data (balance, income, expenses, withholdings) for a given account.
Fitness score for default account The system must compute the fitness score using a default account when no account name is specified.
Fitness score account not found error The system must raise a ValueError when the specified account is not found in the data for fitness computation.
Monthly spending breakdown The system must return a monthly spending breakdown (buildup) for a given account showing expenses categorized by type.
Monthly spending breakdown for default account The system must compute the monthly spending breakdown using a default account when no account name is specified.
Monthly spending breakdown account not found error The system must raise a ValueError when the specified account has no balances or expenses data for the monthly breakdown.
Data file backup before overwrite The system should create a backup of existing data files before overwriting them with seed data.
